snippet.title: 2XKO Early Access Announcement | Dev Update
snippet.description:
2XKO Early Access is coming to PC on October 7. Learn more at https://play2xko.com.

2XKO is a free 2v2 fighting game featuring the iconic champions from League of Legends. Team up with or against friends for explosive 2v2 showdowns, mastering a variety of unique tag and assist mechanics to take down the enemy duo.

#2XKO #RiotGames

Find us on:
Facebook: https://facebook.com/play2XKO
Instagram: https://instagram.com/2XKO
X: https://twitter.com/play2XKO
TikTok: https://tiktok.com/@2xko
Twitch: https://www.twitch.tv/2xko
